capabilities.rationale: The issuer-parameterized SEC 13F certifier is fail-closed audit and certification infrastructure. It intentionally remains non-GUI while BPOP parity is enforced and OFG/EVTC certification is issuer-specific. GUI or Deep Dive exposure is a separate promotion decision permitted only after the issuer reaches zero-residue PASS; mapping the certifier itself to a user-facing surface would incorrectly conflate backend certification machinery with certified issuer data. The callable CLI is an implementation surface, not a user-required terminal workflow, so the active internal capability does not require terminal access.
